items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: That was quite a package with Stan Getz and the Montgomery Brothers featuring Gene Ammons.

ctx.x: After we were there, and got so we were established, the group had got so established that when there was a concert in town, after the concert, all the musicians from the concert would head there, because that's where the happening was at, as far as jazz.

Now, we had to close the place. The liquor law was to close it depending on what time zone you were in, what slot you were in, we had to close at 12, or daylight saving or whatever, it would be one o'clock. But whatever time it was that was the closing period, when there was a concert in town, the musicians would come where we were for a jam session afterwards. So they locked the door and pulled the shade down, and we'd play all night long. I mean, all night long. There were times Count Basie's whole band was in…
